scope: Current public/kernel Python modules loaded into offline Node/Pyodide, with identical source-module hashes. This does not test browser UI, equilibrium convergence, archived ASWING output agreement, dist, downloadable bundles or hosted deployment.
comparison_scope: Fixture outputs can be compared across native and WASM runtimes. No native run is performed by this harness; the 3e-14 absolute fixture gate tests exact constructed geometry, not archived ASWING acceptance.
